title: Shell-company determination run manifest (v0.3, lineage cohort)
description: Immutable record of one Stage 00B-S shell-company determination run over a whole acquisition lineage (ADR-102). The v0.2 predecessor records bundle_manifest_sha256 as a single string, which no full-cohort run satisfies: the cohort lives in many bundles across many execution runs. This successor binds one ADR-101 acquisition_queue_aggregate_manifest@0.2.0 instead, by path, hash and run id, and lists every shard it consumed. The aggregate is the sole authority root: the consumer takes no shard-output root, bundle directory, replay directory, glob or search path, and every directory it opened is exactly a shards_authoritative[].run_dir value from that validated manifest. superseded_directories and shards_not_authoritative are counted here and never resolved or opened. Each referenced bundle and acquisition manifest was re-hashed against the aggregate's record before any primary document was read, and every primary was then verified for byte length and SHA-256 by the unchanged bundle loader. Determination records keep the v0.2 record contract unchanged and are written in shard_index ascending order, then in each bundle manifest's own entry order, so the output is independent of the order the execution run ids were enumerated. firms_excluded equals exactly the count of true determinations; false and unknown are retained. The 0.1.0 and 0.2.0 schemas are retained unchanged and remain the only validators for artefacts written under those contracts; this file never validates one of them, and neither validates a 0.3.0 manifest.

determination_contract.description: The record contract is unchanged. A row determined through the lineage path and through the single-bundle path yields an identical record; only the run manifest describing the run is versioned here.

execution_run_ids.description: Copied verbatim from the aggregate, in the order the aggregate recorded. Provenance only: it orders nothing here, and permuting it cannot move a determination record.

shards_consumed.description: Every shard whose bundle was read, ordered by shard_index. Exactly the aggregate's authoritative records; nothing else was opened.

carrier_provenance.description: One triple for the whole cohort. Every consumed bundle declared the same carrier run id, carrier manifest hash and freeze record hash; disagreement is refused, never reconciled.

supported_transforms.description: Exactly the five transforms a v0.2 record run resolves, unchanged by this successor.

superseded_directories_ignored.description: Named by the aggregate and never resolved or opened here.
